description: Construction of replacement double-glazed infill extension at lower ground and ground floor levels, and associated works including installation of a new rooflight and a roof lantern; lowering of existing floor levels at lower ground floor; installation of replacement external metal staircase in a new covered stair enclosure; installation of new casement window within existing opening to lower ground floor bathroom. enlargement of rear window at third floor level above the closet wing; installation of two external air condensers on main roof level and associated internal service runs; reconfiguration of the internal plan-form; and internal works including refurbishment of mouldings, cornices, skirting boards, and internal doors throughout and installation of joinery units, wet underfloor heating, radiators, electric underfloor heating, AV and security system, drainage system, bathrooms, sanitary-ware and plumbing, electrical wiring. ***WITHDRAWN***
